---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] - "
labels: enhancement, needs-discussion
assignees: Madhu-36
---

## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves
What problem does this feature solve? Who would benefit from it?
> *Example: "As a farmer in Karnataka, I struggle to use the app in Kannada. A language toggle would help me understand the AI predictions better."*

## 📐 Proposed Solution
How do you envision this feature working? Describe the ideal implementation.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Have you considered other approaches? Why did you settle on this solution?

## 📊 Impact Assessment
- **Who benefits?** (farmers / developers / admins)
- **How many users affected?** (estimated)
- **Priority level?** (Low / Medium / High / Critical)

## 📸 Mockups / Examples
If you have sketches, wireframes, or examples from other apps, add them here.

## 📝 Additional Context
Any other relevant context, links, or references.
